title: Room Reservations Rate Plan Schedule: Price Position, Occupancy and Inclusions
content:
Each of the eight Room Reservations rate plans is positioned against the hotel's Flexible Rate for the same room type and night, covers a fixed number of adults, and either includes breakfast or does not. The figures below are the plan's own; they apply at every Ashbury hotel that sells the plan.

## Schedule

| Rate plan | Discount off the Flexible Rate | Package supplement per night (USD) | Adults covered by the nightly rate | Extra-adult charge per night (USD) | Oldest age of a child not counted as an adult | Breakfast included | Breakfast covers per night |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate | 15% | 0.00 | 2 | 25.00 | 17 | No | 0 |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate | 8% | 0.00 | 2 | 25.00 | 17 | No | 0 |
| Flexible Rate | 0% | 0.00 | 2 | 25.00 | 17 | No | 0 |
| Member Flexible Rate | 7% | 0.00 | 2 | 25.00 | 17 | No | 0 |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate | 0% | 32.00 | 2 | 35.00 | 17 | Yes | 2 |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | 10% | 0.00 | 2 | 0.00 | 17 | No | 0 |
| Group Block Rate | 0% | 0.00 | 2 | 0.00 | 17 | No | 0 |
| Reward Night Rate | 0% | 0.00 | 2 | 0.00 | 17 | No | 0 |

## What each column means

- **Discount off the Flexible Rate** is the percentage below the Flexible Rate for the same room type and night at which the plan is priced. A figure of 0% means the plan is priced at, above or independently of the Flexible Rate; it does not mean the plan always equals the Flexible Rate.
- **Package supplement per night** is the amount added to the Flexible Rate per night for the inclusions of the plan.
- **Adults covered by the nightly rate** is the number of adults the nightly rate already pays for.
- **Extra-adult charge per night** is the charge per night for each adult beyond the adults covered.
- **Oldest age of a child not counted as an adult** is the oldest age at which a child sharing existing bedding is not counted as an extra adult.
- **Breakfast included** and **breakfast covers per night** state whether breakfast is part of the plan and how many persons' breakfast is included each night.

## Reading the schedule

**Which plan carries a package supplement?** Only the Bed & Breakfast Package Rate: 32.00 per night, and it is also the only plan that includes breakfast, with 2 covers per night. Every other plan shows 0.00 and no breakfast.

**Do all plans cover the same number of adults?** Yes. Every plan's nightly rate covers 2 adults, and a child aged 17 or younger sharing existing bedding is not counted as an adult on any plan.

**Where does an extra adult cost nothing?** On the Corporate Negotiated Rate, the Group Block Rate and the Reward Night Rate the extra-adult charge is 0.00. It is 25.00 on the Advance Purchase Non-Refundable, Semi-Flexible Saver, Flexible and Member Flexible Rates, and 35.00 on the Bed & Breakfast Package Rate.

**Which plans sit furthest below the Flexible Rate?** In order of discount: the Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate (15%), the Corporate Negotiated Rate (10%), the Semi-Flexible Saver Rate (8%) and the Member Flexible Rate (7%).
